items.title: Jordan Davis: Being traded to Jaguars
items.text:
The Eagles are trading Davis to the Jaguars, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Joshua Palmer: Headed to injured reserve
items.text:
Palmer (hamstring) was placed on injured reserve Monday, Joe Buscaglia of the Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Puka Nacua: IR stint appears likely
items.text:
Coach Sean McVay indicated Monday that Nacua (knee) is likely headed to injured reserve with a PCL/MCL sprain and turf toe, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jake Ferguson: In line to miss multiple weeks, per coach
items.text:
According to coach Brian Schottenheimer, Ferguson (knee) is in line to miss multiple weeks, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Gardner Minshew: Set to undergo testing on arm/elbow
items.text:
Minshew is slated undergo testing on his right elbow/arm in the wake of Sunday's loss to the Seahawks, according to Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Michael Wilson: Out for season with neck injury
items.text:
Coach Mike LaFleur revealed Monday that Wilson is out for the season due to a fracture in his neck, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
